run_update_pkls: run the update_pkls function to migrate adsorbates and bulks pickle files from ASE v3.19 to v3.21
run_update_dbs: run the update_dbs function to migrate adsorbates and bulks ASE database files from v3.19 to v3.21
run_update_script: run the main update script to migrate all OC database pickle and ASE db files to v3.21
review_pbc_patch: review the pbc_patch monkey patch that adds a PBC property getter to ASE Atoms objects
review_set_pbc_patch: review the set_pbc_patch monkey patch that adds a PBC setter to ASE Atoms objects
